newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai GDP up 12.8 pct in first 10 months.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai GDP up 12.8 pct in first 10 months.

text.p: Shanghai's gross domestic product (GDP) for the first 10 months of 1996 was up 12.8 percent over the same 1995 period, indicating the city's growth continues to be rapid and steady, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

The agency quoted a report from the Shanghai Statistics Bureau as saying GDP in the January-October period was 229.75 billion yuan, while GDP for the month of October was 25.248 billion yuan, up 14.8 percent over October 1995.
Industrial output value for the 10-month period hit 224.76 billion yuan, 18.3 percent higher than the corresponding period last year.

Retail sales volume in the January-October period was 95.256 billion yuan, a rise of 19.8 percent while Shanghai's exports reached $11.084 billion, an increase of 12.8 percent over the same 1995 period.
Fixed asset investment in the period totalled 103.17 billion yuan this year, up 37.6 percent from the first ten months of 1995.
